project_title: Roberta's Beauty Dog Center - Italian Boutique Dog Grooming Salon

theme.emotional_archetype: Organic & Earthy / Italian Ligurian Boutique Warmth

typography.headline_font: Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond / Serif Display
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Manrope, or Inter

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold text-[#6E8B74]

responsive.layout: Design mobile-first with flex-col, grid-cols-1 on small screens, scaling up to md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Ensure mobile padding (p-4) and spacing (gap-6) avoid awkward margins. Touch targets minimum 44px height.
responsive.typography: Mobile fluid scaling starting at text-3xl for H1 up to text-5xl on desktop. Form inputs size text-base (16px) on mobile to prevent iOS auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Use overflow-x-hidden on root wrapper, max-w-full on images and containers.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons, icon triggers, tab switches, and links must have min-height of 44px and generous padding.

hero_grooming_trim.description: Professional groomer trimming a fluffy dog in a warm salon environment
hero_grooming_trim.placement: Hero section badge/card overlay or main hero image frame

cocker_spaniel_post_groom.description: Beautifully groomed American Cocker Spaniel with shiny coat
cocker_spaniel_post_groom.placement: Services section or Taglio & Tosatura feature card

dog_in_bath_towel.description: Dog sitting peacefully in a bathtub next to a soft towel
dog_in_bath_towel.placement: Bagno & Asciugatura service card / Spa treatments

frenchie_bath_smile.description: Happy small dog getting a relaxing bubbly bath
frenchie_bath_smile.placement: Spa & Trattamenti Extra card or gallery item

shih_tzu_running.description: Fluffy white puppy running happily after salon visit
shih_tzu_running.placement: About us / Salon Story section illustration

golden_retriever_tulip.description: Happy Golden Retriever with a flower, representing love and care
golden_retriever_tulip.placement: Testimonials or Booking section side accent

key_components.name: Header & Mobile Nav
key_components.description: Glassmorphism sticky header with Ligurian terracotta accents, logo with paw badge, navigation links (Home, Servizi, Chi Siamo, Contatti, Prenota), and Staff Access button.

key_components.name: Hero Section
key_components.description: Warm Ligurian terracotta & cream backdrop, elegant Italian typography ('Il Benessere del Tuo Cane nel Cuore della Liguria'), key call-to-actions, badge with phone (+39 338 292 9207), rating badge, and photo stack.

key_components.name: Services Grid (I Nostri Servizi)
key_components.description: 5 Core Services cards with price range, estimated duration, description, and direct 'Prenota Questo Servizio' button: 1) Bagno & Asciugatura, 2) Taglio & Tosatura, 3) Taglio Unghie, 4) Pulizia Orecchie & Denti, 5) Spa & Trattamenti Extra.

key_components.name: Online Booking Section & Modal/Form
key_components.description: Friendly multi-step or unified booking form with validation: Nome, Cognome, Telefono, Razza Cane, Taglia Cane, Servizio richiesto, Data preferita, Note particolari.

key_components.name: Staff Login & Verification Dashboard
key_components.description: Staff Portal with login tab (Email + Password, demo credentials provided: staff@robertabeautydog.it / password123). Dashboard displays list of pending, confirmed, and rejected bookings with customer phone, first name, last name verification panel before clicking 'Conferma' or 'Rifiuta'. Filterable by status.

key_components.name: Salon Story & Values (Chi Siamo)
key_components.description: Story of Roberta and her passion for dogs in Borghetto Santo Spirito. Warm photos, gentle hygiene approach, low-stress handling.

key_components.name: Contact, Location & Opening Hours
key_components.description: Address: Corso Europa, 22, 17020 Borghetto Santo Spirito SV. Phone: +39 338 292 9207. Interactive embedded Google Maps or custom stylized map card, opening hours table (Lun-Sab 08:30 - 18:30, Dom Chiuso).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the frontend in React JS with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React or Phosphor icons.
Ensure all copy is grammatically fluent, authentic, and inviting Italian (e.g., 'Roberta's Beauty Dog Center - Toilettatura Professionale e Spa per Cani').
Provide a smooth Staff Login switch or page view so the owner Roberta and her staff can switch to the 'Area Riservata Staff' to view and confirm appointments.
In the Staff Dashboard, prominently display the customer verification fields (Nome, Cognome, Numero di Telefono) and an explicit 'Verifica Dati' section before confirming or rejecting.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes matching the design_guidelines specification.
Use warm terracotta (#C86D51), sage green (#6E8B74), and creamy warm whites (#FDFBF7) to avoid AI purple/violet gradients.
Use Sonner for toasts when bookings are submitted or staff actions are completed.
